title: Smooth cutoff equal to one near a compact subset of an open ball
statement: Let k ∈ ℕ, h > 0 and K ⊆ ℝ^k compact with K ⊆ B_h(0). Then there is a C^∞ function η : ℝ^k → ℝ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η) with compact support and tsupport η ⊆ B_h(0) such that every w ∈ K has a neighbourhood on which η ≡ 1 (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 w, η y = 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid k)) (h : ℝ), 0 < h → IsCompact K → K ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid k) h → ∃ η : Euclid k → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ tsupport η ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid k) h ∧ ∀ w ∈ K, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 w, η y = 1
